title: Review custody for chg-dispatched reviews

story.i_want_to: have chg's review jobs record verdicts under a lineage separate from every implementer
story.so_that: a story implemented and landed through chg can still be verified with its custody intact

rationale: PRD §6. chg auto-approves some classes and runs reviews headless; loopctl's custody must still hold.

acceptance_criteria.description: The operator mints chg-server's key as a parentless orchestrator-role dispatch with the existing POST /api/v1/dispatches; no new mint path and no change to root_dispatch_forbidden or the role ceiling.
review_records gains a nullable commit_sha. review_complete for a chg-mode story requires it and refuses a sha that is not a revision of the story's current binding with 422 commit_sha_not_bound.
self_review_blocked, caller_lineage_required and unresolvable_dispatch_lineage behave unchanged for a chg-minted reviewer key; a reviewer key on the implementer's chain is refused.
A landed event for a story-bound change with no review_records row for its landed revision leaves the story at merged flagged review_missing and escalates it; it never verifies.
verify_story on a chg-mode story requires a review_records row whose commit_sha is the landed revision.

test_cases.name: separate root passes
preconditions: implementer under root R1, reviewer under chg root R2
steps: review_complete with the R2 child key

test_cases.name: same chain refused
preconditions: reviewer key a descendant of the implementer's dispatch

test_cases.name: verdict on a stale revision
preconditions: review recorded on revision 1, revision 2 landed
expected_results: refused: no review for the landed revision

test_cases.name: auto-approved landing
preconditions: a docs-class change bound to a story, no review

technical_notes: Do not convert any exact_role gate to role:. Do not let commit_sha come from anything but the request body checked against the binding.
